QuestInfo.name: Princess Suzume is Super Nice
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Hoshi, who's playing outside Sakura Castle.
QuestInfo.1: Hoshi says Princess Suzume can see the truth of any situation, but she's been locked up because she secretly met with her friend Fuji. If you want to enter the castle, you'll have to talk to Daisuke.

Frogs go ribbit ribbit until you step on them, SPLAT!
Toads go croak croak until you sit on them, OOMPH!
When the world drips in poison, the cherry blossoms go--#k
#L0##bHey, kid! What are you singing?#l
#k
0.1: Darned if I know, but it sure it catchy. Everyone says if I sing it too much, the Gigatoad will kidnap me, but HA. I'd like to see him try!\r\n#L0##bRiiight. Say, do you happen to know who I should talk to about entering the castle?#l\n#k
0.2: That'd be Daisuke. He's a castle guard and knows the BEST stories. He told me Princess Suzume can see the truth of ANY object, place, or person! No idea what that means, but she's super nice! She always gives me candy. My favorite is gumdr--\r\n#L0##bShe sounds like a great person.#l\n#k
0.3: Yup, but she got in trouble for talking to #bFuji#k and is locked away in the Imperial Villa. So unfair. They were best friends as kids! Why shouldn't they talk to each other? Anyway, when I grow up, I'm going to be one of the princess's personal guards! \r\n#L0##bWhat else do you know about her?#l\n#k
0.4: Not much. Go talk to  #bDaisuke#k if you want to know more. I'm not much of a talker.

no.0: I told you, I don't much like talking! Go away!
